title: SOFA: Study on Omega-3 Fatty Acids and Ventricular Arrhythmia

sections.abstract: The objective of the SOFA trial is to investigate whether supplemental intake of n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids (n-3 PUFA) from fish oil can reduce the recurrence of life-threatening ventricular arrhythmias in patients with an implantable cardioverter defibrillator (ICD).
